Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) Shareholder Salzman & Company Has Lowered Position by $22.97 Million; Ballentine Partners Increases Position in Apple (AAPL)
June 29, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Salzman & Company decreased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 53.22% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Salzman & Company sold 765,762 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.63% with the market. The hedge fund held 673,227 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $20.49M, down from 1.44M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Salzman & Company who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $21.33 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.93% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $26.39. About 483,895 shares traded. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 7.09% since June 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.66% the S&P500. Ballentine Partners Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2478% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ballentine Partners Llc bought 61,950 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 64,450 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.81 million, up from 2,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ballentine Partners Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $915.89B market cap company.
